name: registry.value.read
description: Read a single registry value's type and data. Use `registry.key.read` to enumerate a key's subkeys and value names.

path.description: Registry key path in `HKLM\Software\...` form (or `HKCU`, `HKCR`, `HKU`, `HKCC` roots). Hive abbreviations expanded server-side.

value.description: Value name. Empty string for the (Default) value.

data.description: Value data as a string. REG_SZ/REG_EXPAND_SZ/REG_LINK: the literal string. REG_DWORD/REG_QWORD: decimal-stringified integer. REG_BINARY: base64. REG_MULTI_SZ: null-byte-separated, with a trailing null.

windows-modern.description: RegOpenKeyExW + RegQueryValueExW. KEY_READ access. WoW64 redirection follows the agent's bitness.

windows-classic.description: Same Win32 APIs since NT 3.1. NT 4 / 9x agents use RegQueryValueExA with ANSI transcoding.
